warning: These are separate stored measurements, not one time series: the event set, the code and the estimator all change between rows. Each row carries its own venue and artifact.

entries.label: v2.1 baseline — no selection machinery
entries.what: A raw per-event distance-redshift product: no Gray D(h), no zero-fill p_det, no completeness. Interior, recovers the injected 0.73; edge mass ~1e-36.

entries.label: v2.2 — selection switched ON, rails to 0.86
entries.what: The Gray selection/completeness machinery is switched on (zero-fill p_det a70d1a2 + Gray D(h) 2853c32). The posterior rails to the upper grid edge.

entries.label: zero-fill p_det fixed — interior, +4.8% high
entries.map_note: interior but +4.8% high (no single MAP recorded in the digest)
entries.what: Fixing the p_det zero-fill de-rails it, but leaves a +4.8% high bias.

entries.label: interior, persistently +1.5–4% high
entries.map_note: +1.5–4% high, seed-dependent; the h-grid is narrowed to [0.70, 0.80]
entries.what: Two months of interior-but-high posteriors. The narrowed grid is itself part of the archaeology: a grid that cannot show a rail will not show you one.

entries.label: restructure to the single Gray ratio
entries.map_note: structural change, no MAP recorded at this commit
entries.what: The per-event likelihood becomes one quotient, p_i = (β_G·L_cat + B_num)/D(h).

entries.label: seed600 at HEAD rails to 0.86 again
entries.what: The auditor's own re-run: posterior argmax 0.86 while D(h)'s own argmax is 0.60 — the rail is back, and it is normalization-shaped.

entries.label: de-rail matrix, step 1: pre-4π
entries.what: The de-rail matrix starts where the audit left it: railed HIGH.

entries.label: de-rail matrix, step 2: 4π sky marginal only
entries.what: Fixing the completion term's 4π sky marginal flips the rail from the top of the grid to the bottom — necessary, not sufficient.

entries.label: de-rail matrix, step 3: local_ratio
entries.what: A locally-normalized ratio of sums puts 98% of the posterior mass on an interior peak at truth.

entries.label: de-rail matrix, step 4: volume_deconv
entries.what: The ratified host-z volume kernel keeps it there.

entries.label: campaign #51 — idealized baseline
entries.venue: seed61000, point kernel + generator_marginal, unscattered catalogue
entries.what: 1D 0.72990 (−0.24σ), 2D 0.7300 (−0.36σ) on a 1e-4 zoom grid. 100% of the information comes from 76 in-catalogue events; 3 golden events carry 46%.

entries.label: campaign #53 — realistic run
entries.venue: seed61000/62000, absolute_marginal + volume_deconv, scattered catalogue, 10 runs
entries.what: 1D 0.700–0.740 (pooled 0.7205); 2D 0.780–0.820, mean bias +0.077, 10/10 runs pull > 2σ. The 2D pairing is a designated CANDIDATE, not ratified ground.
